_comment: The SEC requires automated tools to identify themselves. Replace the placeholder below with your real name and email, or set the EDGAR_USER_AGENT environment variable instead. Without this, EDGAR ingestion is skipped and you get ClinicalTrials.gov data only.
_comment2: The macro page runs on FRED. Get a free key at https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/apikeys (one minute, no payment details), then put it here or set FRED_API_KEY. Without it the macro tab explains what is missing and the rest of the site is unaffected.
